q: The singular value decomposition A = UΣVᵀ of an m×n matrix A relates to its eigendecomposition by the fact that the singular values are:
opts: Square roots of eigenvalues of AᵀA
exp: Singular values σᵢ = √λᵢ(AᵀA). The right singular vectors (columns of V) are eigenvectors of AᵀA; left singular vectors (U) are eigenvectors of AAᵀ.
